## Expression on this line

The Health line at orange Stage 11 is **rights-equal-procedure distribution of biomedical
service**. The transition is from amber's biomedical-as-membership-gated-service to orange's
biomedical-as-public-domain subordinated to a rights-based regime: the same universal right to
clinically-indicated biomedical care across class, ethnos, religion, sect, or geography; a
published, transparent, auditable set of coverage-decisions rather than executive-curtain
discretion; an evidence-based population medicine that the named-individual and the system can
read together.

The structural changes are:

- **Universal coverage by statute and operation.** A published-statutory universal-coverage
  regime including explicit reduction-or-elimination of class-correlated out-of-pocket cost
  barriers; published-services benefit schedule; published-reduction-in-coverage-disparities
  time series.
- **Standing-regulator independent of the executive.** A regulator-statute governing-list of
  coverage, formulary, pricing-rules, and licensing, with statutory independence arms-length
  from the executive; transparency-report and audit-cycle.
- **Evidence-based population-medicine discipline.** Clinical-practice-guidelines process with
  published-evidence-basis-records, comparative-effectiveness-published-edition, and a
  population-registry system that records health-outcomes regardless of access-discretion.
- **Coverage-disparities time series.** Published comparative-effectiveness and outcome data
  with class-axes; published remedial-action plans and a published-monitor-regulator-role.
- **Cross-jurisdiction benchmark.** International standards for biomedical-system-effectiveness,
  with active participation in cross-jurisdiction benchmark exercises; published-benchmark
  performance.
- **Patient-rights framework.** Patients' charter-with-justice-content; published-statutory
  patient-rights; independent patient-ombudsman at sub-statutory level.
- **Industrial-pharmaceutical regulatory independence.** Formulary-and-pricing authority statutory-
  independence; published-transparency; *R&D-derived* cost-accounting.

## Integrity markers (healthy inclusion — what a higher CoG must keep from orange-11)

- **UL:** the clinical practitioner's internalized *rights-as-vocational* identity — the *work*
  is realized through respect for patient autonomy and equal individual standing, including
  across social categories.
- **UR:** independent regulator, statute-published coverage-decisions, evidence-based clinical
  practice guidelines, public-aggregate-metric publication.
- **LL:** *civic-modernist universal-coverage faith*: a polity that recognizes biomedical-care
  as a public-domain governed by rights-equal-procedure, and contests residual class-correlated
  remit.
- **LR:** universal-coverage statute, regulator-statute with independence, evidence-based
  practice-guidelines statute, patients' rights statute, industrial-pharmaceutical regulator
  statutory, coverage-disparities-published-monitor-regulator.

## Pathology markers (Agape / Eros)

- **Dark addiction (clinging to orange-11):** **coverage-rationality-rapture** — quantitative-
  metrics-producing discipline becomes a substitute for the substantive-immersion in
  patient-and-population narrative. The published-statistical-frame responds to itself and
  narrows attention to the outcomes that metrics measure.
- **Dark allergy (orange-11 foundation skipped/fragile):** statutory-universal-coverage-
  architecture on the statute-book without operating-discipline delivery; published-coverage-
  rights with delivery-pay-statistic-binding absent; published-by-form regulator with operating-
  capture visible in audit; statutory-supervisory authority without independent budget.
- **Golden addiction (grasping Green prematurely):** **multi-stakeholder-networked-health-
  governance** — multi-stakeholder network-objects regarded-as-equivalent substantive
  regulation; quorate-stakeholder governance-without-named-justice-as-discipline displaces
  individual-rights-equal-procedure.
- **Golden allergy (Jonah / refusing orange-11):** nativist-refusal to biomedical-stage-rs-and-
  rights, treating universal-coverage as alien or anti-traditional, sliding-back to amber
  regime-keeping memberships.

## Diagnostic cues (universal signal-types)

Falsifiable signal *types* place a health-system holon at **orange Stage 11**.

- **Coverage-disparities persistent-reduction.** Class-correlated-outcome differentials are
  published-trended and statistical-significantly-reduction across cycles, with published-
  remedial action plans and published-applied-procedure mechanisms.
- **Coverage-statute parity-universal.** Coverage-statutory-framing available to any resident
  regardless of class, ethnos, religion, sect, geography, with operational parity of
  delivery.
- **Independent regulator statutory-independent.** A regulator-statute governing the system
  has statutory independence arms-length from the executive; transparency-report published;
  audit-cycle reportable to a legislature, multi-stakeholder body, or comparable.
- **Evidence-based-practice-guidelines published.** Clinical-practice-guidelines process
  *published-evidence basis*, with comparable-effectiveness publication and clinical-agencies'
  practice-update-disclosed process.
- **Population-registry capture-uniform.** Population-registry-disclosure captures outcomes
  across the population, with published-monitor and published-monitor-quality-statistical.
- **Coverage-decisions published a priori.** A published-coverage-decision process precedes
  delivery, not after-the-fact.
- **Coverage-discounts/news-statistical.** Class-correlated-discounts series over time, with
  reduction-trending.
